cases.name: Ann Elizabeth Corriea Mannix
cases.about:
She was a retired ex-San Francisco Police Department Deputy Chief. Ann climbed the ranks of the San Francisco Police Department, becoming deputy chief of the Field Operations Bureau in 2018 before taking charge of the Special Operations Bureau in 2019, according to department records.

She also made history as the first woman to serve on the department’s SWAT team and eventually lead the unit.
